prompt: Create a polished visual concept comparison sheet for a children's modular sticker creature game called Neurofauna. Landscape 1536x1024. Layout: left one third shows exactly six separate stickers in a neat 2-column 3-row layout: a friendly lion head with mane looking right, a rounded blue shark torso WITHOUT head limbs or tail, scorpion pincer forelegs, chunky lion hind legs, curved green crocodile tail extending left, rounded turtle shell back accessory. Right two thirds shows ONE large fully assembled funny lovable chimera constructed by overlapping those EXACT SAME six pieces: shark torso central and horizontal, lion head attached at upper right, crocodile tail attached at left, lion hind legs beneath left rear, scorpion claw forelegs beneath right front, turtle shell attached above torso. Attachment points must touch and overlap so the creature is a coherent single character standing on four appendages, never an exploded diagram. Each separate piece must faithfully match its assembled counterpart in shape and color. Very clear readable full body silhouette with generous margins. White die-cut sticker edge around each part, tiny contact shadows where stickers overlap. Emphasize a fun DIY sticker collage assembled by a child. Friendly bright eyes, cheeky smile, charming mismatched proportions. No severed flesh, holes, wounds, gore, scary content. No text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks. Background simple warm notebook paper with faint graph grid and small decorative stars; do not put decorations inside silhouettes. This is a style-selection mockup, not production assets. STYLE A: contemporary flat children's sticker-book illustration. Big squishy rounded shapes, simple clean dark aubergine outlines, no sharp spikes, 2-tone flat cel shading. Sunny yellow lion mane, blue-teal shark, mint tail and turtle shell, coral pincers, warm ochre paws, restrained lavender details. Charming cartoon eyes and expression. Fresh playful confident design, the feeling of a really good cute collectible sticker pack. Smooth vector-like fills, mostly flat, no 3D, no detailed texture.
